finders.title: Earn from the tips you already give.
finders.sub: You don't need to be a salesperson. You share a link with someone who needs something. When the job goes ahead, a finder's fee lands in your account.
finders.how1: Create an account with your email or Google. You only need your name, date of birth and city.
finders.how2: Pick a business that fits what someone is looking for. You see right away what you can earn.
finders.how3: Share your personal link via WhatsApp, copy it, or let someone scan the QR code.
finders.how4: Follow your customer: request, quote, won, done. You only see first name and city; the rest stays private.
finders.how5: Once the business has paid, your fee is in your balance. From € 25 you can request a payout.
finders.earnSub: Worked examples based on a typical job and a common fee. The actual fee is shown on each campaign.
finders.ranksSub: The more paid deals you bring in, the bigger your share of every fee. You never earn from other people's work.
finders.payoutBody: Your balance has three parts. Expected: deals that were won but not yet paid by the business. Available: the business paid, you can withdraw it. Paid out: it's in your bank account. From € 25 available you can request a payout. We transfer it to your own IBAN and you get a PDF statement.
finders.bonusFirst: First-deal bonus: an extra amount on your very first paid deal.
finders.bonusRepeat: Repeat customer: if your customer comes back within 12 months for a new job through FindersArmy, you earn again.
finders.bonusInvite: Invite a friend: a one-off € 25 when a friend you invited brings in their first paid deal. Strictly one level, never recurring.
finders.rule2: You can't refer yourself, not even through someone else.
finders.rule3: Only share your link with people who actually need something. Spam costs you your account.
finders.rule4: You only earn from customers you bring in yourself.

business.title: Only pay for customers who actually come in.
business.sub: People trust a tip from someone they know more than an ad. FindersArmy puts thousands of those tips to work for you. You pay a finder's fee when a referred customer becomes your customer. Otherwise nothing.
business.ctaNote: Takes 5 minutes. You go live after review.
business.vs2: No cost per click or per lead
business.vs3: Nothing for requests that go nowhere
business.vs4: No direct debit: you pay per invoice
business.feeBody: You choose one rule per campaign: a percentage of the job amount, a fixed amount per won deal, or tiers. You also set a minimum job amount: below it you pay nothing. The minimum fee makes sure a Finder never works for nothing.
business.feePercentageEx: For example 8% of the job amount. For painters, installers, renovators.
business.feeFixedEx: For example € 200 per car sold. For dealers, driving schools, gyms.
business.feeTieredEx: For example € 100 below € 10,000 and € 250 above. For kitchens, solar panels, wedding venues.
business.calcTitle: What does a customer cost you?
business.calcSub: Enter your average job amount and fee. This is what you pay per customer who comes in through FindersArmy.
business.calcResultNote: excl. VAT. You pay nothing for requests you don't win.
business.calcShareOfJob: of your revenue on this job
business.process1: You sign up and set your fee. We verify your details.
business.process2: Finders share your campaign with people who need something.
business.process3: Requests come in. Respond within 48 hours and keep the status up to date.
business.process4: When you win the job, enter the deal amount. After completion the customer confirms.
business.process5: You receive an invoice with an iDEAL payment link. Payment term 14 days.
business.clauseBody: A customer who comes to you through FindersArmy counts as referred for 12 months, even if you later make arrangements outside the platform. That's not to trap you. It's the only way a Finder can trust their tip gets paid. We also check: customers confirm themselves that the job was done.
business.clauseNote: Set out formally in the terms for businesses, article 6.
business.boostBody: Need to move something? Temporarily raise your fee (“+ € 100 this week”) or boost a specific product. Your campaign gets a badge and sits at the top for Finders.
business.excludedBody: Real estate brokerage, mortgages, insurance and other financial products, legal services and medical care are excluded at launch. Paid customer referral is more strictly regulated there.

how.title: A tip, a link, a fee.
how.sub: FindersArmy has three sides. Here's how it works for each.
findersSteps: Creates a free account and picks a business.
Shares their personal link with someone who needs something.
Follows the request in their overview.
Receives a finder's fee when the job goes ahead and the business has paid.
customerSteps: Gets a link from someone they know.
Requests a quote through that link. No account needed.
Gets called or emailed by the business.
Confirms with one click afterwards that the job was done, and receives a gift card.
businessSteps: Signs up and sets a finder's fee.
Receives requests and keeps their status up to date.
Enters the amount when a deal is won.
Pays the fee per invoice, only for customers who actually became customers.
how.pipelineSub: Every request goes through the same steps. The Finder sees all of them.
how.moneyBody: Most of every fee goes to the Finder: 60% to 70%, depending on their rank. When the customer confirms the job, they receive a gift card. What remains is for FindersArmy. That pays for the platform, the checks and the payouts.
how.fair1: Customers confirm themselves that the job was done, and for what amount.
how.fair2: You can't refer yourself. We recognise your email, phone and device.
how.fair3: The same customer at the same business within 90 days counts once. The first Finder wins.
how.fair4: Businesses that don't respond or don't pay drop in the list and get paused.
how.fair5: No pyramid. You never earn from your network's network.

about.title: Tips have always been work. Now they get paid.
about.p1: The best customers come through word of mouth. Every tradesperson knows it. The neighbour who recommends their painter, the colleague who suggests a driving school, the friend who knows which dealer is honest. Those tips are worth thousands to businesses. The person who gave the tip gets a thank-you, if they're lucky.
about.p2: FindersArmy turns that into a fair exchange. Businesses only pay when a referred customer actually becomes a customer. The Finder gets most of that fee. No subscriptions, no leads to buy, no promises about reach.
about.p3: We keep it simple and verifiable. Customers confirm themselves that the work was done. Fees are calculated with fixed rules the business sets itself. A Finder's balance is always the sum of a ledger nobody can overwrite.
about.principle1: No pyramid. You only earn from customers you bring in yourself.
about.principle2: No fake numbers. What we show comes from our books.
about.principle3: No selling personal data. Customer details only go to the business the customer contacted.
about.principle4: No sectors where paid referral is regulated, such as mortgages and healthcare.
about.statusBody: FindersArmy has just launched in the Netherlands. We start in South Holland and expand once a region has enough active businesses and Finders.
